description: Solid fills: rectangles on whole and half pixels, a sub-pixel sliver, a triangle and a diagonal quad in Excalidraw's palette, source-over in list order
toleranceNote: Every draw goes through ports of Chrome's own pipeline (Skia's analytic anti-aliasing, edge builder and clipper, stroker, dasher and AntiFillRect, Blink's arc handling), so what remains is rounding in blending, coverage and sampling: against Chrome 153 no pixel here is more than 2 levels off. 8 leaves room for another Chrome build that rounds differently.
